title: Chintamani Library v2.8.8 — Universal QR Portal, Member Archive & Backup System
releaseNotes: PAYMENT SCREENSHOT UPLOAD: 100% reliable upload with multi-format support (JPG/PNG/WEBP up to 10MB) and dual local disk + cloud fallback.
6-MONTH PAYMENT HISTORY: Full chronological payment history per member with explicit CASH classification and color-coded badges.
RECORD CASH PAYMENT: Dedicated modal to record authentic cash payments with zero fake transaction references or screenshots.
PAYMENT VERIFICATION: High-resolution full-screen screenshot preview modal with member identity and rejection reason tracking.
COMPLAINT WORKFLOW: Added RESOLVED_PENDING status with dedicated tab selector and real-time state synchronization.
MEMBER ARCHIVE & RESTORE: Soft-deletion workflow archives members, auto-vacates seats/lockers, with dedicated Archive Directory and safeguarded permanent deletion.
DATABASE RELIABILITY: Zero startup data resets, tuned connection pooling (15 connections), eliminating cold disconnects.
AUTOMATED DAILY BACKUPS: Scheduled 2:00 AM IST database backups (SQL dump + JSON snapshot) with 30-day retention and hourly seat auto-reconciliation.
SEAT MATRIX ALLOCATION: Direct seat assignment to members with live search and atomic database updates.
